stories.title: RJ Mitte ist tot: »Breaking Bad«-Schauspieler mit 34 Jahren gestorben

en.title: RJ Mitte is dead: 'Breaking Bad' actor dies at 34
en.summary: RJ Mitte, who played Walter White's son in the hit series Breaking Bad and lived with cerebral palsy, has died at age 34.

stories.title: Donald Trump: US-Senatoren kritisieren Trumps Diesel-Deal mit Russland

en.title: Donald Trump: US Senators Criticize Trump's Diesel Deal with Russia
en.summary: Donald Trump continues to pursue a diesel deal with Russia. U.S. senators from both parties warn of potential legal violations and consequences for Ukraine.

stories.title: Festnahme nach Ausraster: Selma Blair hat Flugpersonal offenbar gebissen und geschlagen

en.title: Arrest after outburst: Selma Blair apparently bit and hit flight staff
en.summary: US actress Selma Blair allegedly became violent on a flight, biting and hitting crew members and attempting to open a door. Her management provided an explanation for the incident, which is under investigation.

stories.title: Rücktritt von Bärbel Bas: Klingbeil beklagt »vergiftetes« Klima in der Bundespolitik

en.title: Bärbel Bas resignation: Klingbeil laments 'poisoned' climate in federal politics
en.summary: SPD leader Lars Klingbeil renewed his criticism of how Bärbel Bas was treated following her resignation, stating that the political climate in federal government harms people.

stories.title: Selma Blair hat Flugpersonal offenbar gebissen und geschlagen

en.title: Selma Blair apparently bit and hit flight personnel
en.summary: Actress Selma Blair was taken into custody following an alleged attack on a Delta Air Lines flight. Her management attributed her behavior to a health emergency.

stories.title: Brand in Starlink-Station in Polen - Festnahmen in Deutschland

en.title: Fire at Starlink Station in Poland - Arrests in Germany
en.summary: A Starlink station in Poland caught fire in late September. Two suspects were arrested in Germany, with Polish authorities suspecting Russian involvement in the incident.

stories.title: Krieg gegen die Ukraine: Merz sichert Selenskyj in Telefonat Solidarität zu

en.title: War against Ukraine: Merz assures Zelenskyy of solidarity in phone call
en.summary: Germany and Ukraine believe Russia must respond to ceasefire demands. Russia attacked a 25-story residential building in Kyiv.

stories.title: Liveblog Ukrainekrieg: Tusk gibt nach Brand an Starlink-Anlage Festnahmen in Deutschland bekannt

en.title: Ukraine war live blog: Tusk announces arrests in Germany following Starlink facility fire
en.summary: Two Turkish citizens were arrested in Germany on Polish behalf following a fire at a Starlink installation. Russia's response to Trump's energy ceasefire remains unconfirmed, with attacks on Ukrainian energy infrastructure ongoing.

stories.title: Brand an Starlink-Bodenstation: Polen meldet nach Brand in Starlink-Station Festnahmen in Deutschland

en.title: Fire at Starlink ground station: Poland announces arrests in Germany following Starlink station fire
en.summary: Following a fire at a satellite facility, Poland announced arrests of two individuals in Germany. Polish authorities attribute responsibility to Russia.

stories.title: Polen: Brand an Starlink-Station mit möglichem Russlandbezug – Festnahmen in Deutschland

en.title: Poland: Fire at Starlink station with possible Russian connection – arrests in Germany
en.summary: Poland attributes a fire at a Starlink station that provides internet to Ukrainian military to Russian intelligence services. Two Turkish citizens were arrested in Germany as suspects.

stories.title: US-Börsen: US-Börsen schließen uneinheitlich – Ölpreis steigt wieder

en.title: US Markets: US markets close mixed – oil price rises again
en.summary: U.S. stock markets ended the week with mixed results. Microsoft shares notably surpassed an important price level for the first time in approximately one year.

stories.title: +++ Iran-Krieg +++: Angriff auf Flughafen Riad – Reiche saß in Saudi-Arabien fest

en.title: Iran-War: Attack on Riyadh Airport – wealthy person was stranded in Saudi Arabia
en.summary: Iran directed attack plans on a British military base according to officials. Iran also claimed responsibility for an attack on a supertanker in the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Banken: Crédit Agricole übernimmt deutsche Mittelstandsbank IKB

en.title: Banks: Crédit Agricole acquires German mid-market bank IKB
en.summary: The French bank is expanding its operations in the German banking market. The acquisition will be financed from the bank's own resources, with no price disclosed.

stories.title: Bundeswehr: Pistorius sieht Fortschritte bei Digitalisierung des Heeres

en.title: Bundeswehr: Pistorius sees progress in army digitalization
en.summary: New digital radio systems are currently being tested under combat conditions with encouraging results. However, full-scale production integration of the radio equipment remains behind schedule.

stories.title: Kommentar: Fünf magere Seiten bleiben vom angedrohten Aufstand gegen Merz

en.title: Commentary: Five meager pages remain from the threatened uprising against Merz
en.summary: CDU state premiers sought to force a policy correction in Berlin following election defeats in eastern Germany, but neither government personnel nor government policy underwent change.
